verdicts.reason: A breaks the key image apart: the shoe is pulled off its lime circle, leaving the circle empty on the right. The NEW VIDEO pill is clipped at the canvas edge, the VOLTSTRIDE logo is too small to read, the headline is small, and there is a large empty band in the middle. B keeps the brand and gives the one-line headline strong, clear prominence. However, 'Full review inside.' is stacked on top of the lime circle and shoe, an unwanted text collision. The shoe is also squeezed small inside the circle, and the NEW VIDEO pill is crammed under the logo at a tiny size.
